name: Deathguard Linnea
summary: At a roadside post in southeastern Tirisfal, Deathguard Linnea watches the roads between Brill and the eastern borders. Her unit guards against the Scarlet Crusade and the lingering Scourge, with passing travelers sometimes helping on patrol.

sections.title: A Vigil on the Roadside
sections.body: Deathguard Linnea guards a fortified post southeast of Brill. The Forsaken defend their young realm against Scarlet Crusade infiltrators and Scourge still prowling the wilderness. Linnea and her fellow guards patrol the road and coordinate reports with Magistrate Sevren in Brill. Their watch keeps the eastern road toward the Bulwark secure.

faq.answer: Linnea serves in the Deathguard, the Forsaken force that defends their territory. She guards a waystation on the road southeast of Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why does she need help patrolling?
faq.answer: Forsaken forces are spread thin across Tirisfal Glades. Linnea depends on travelers and rising champions to clear nearby threats, so messengers and supply runners can travel safely to and from Brill.

angles.text: As a Forsaken newly risen from Deathknell, you can help Linnea guard the waystation and secure your kingdom's borders.
As an ally of the Forsaken traveling through Tirisfal Glades, you can help Linnea secure the outlying roads against hostile forces.
